ANNEX HK (copied WhatsApp 07:50)

MAIN

SHUTTLE

BREAKFAST

PAYMENT
M116 Ms Brennan — prepaid direct — settled. Ignore collect stamp.

Crew quiet wing clear until tomorrow.
